counting.macOS: Suites and totals are reported separately for each OS/architecture; a case executed on multiple runners is not a unique-case total.
counting.compatibility: Test cases, completed helper checks, and one aggregate native UI receipt have separate units.
counting.unknownCounters: null means not independently reported; success does not imply a measured zero.

suites.name: Platform file operations
suites.skipCounterMeaning: Not separately reported by this harness; no skipped count is inferred.

suites.name: Bundled helper smoke
suites.unreportedCounters: The log emits each successful check and a final passed count. It does not emit failed or skipped totals; the GitHub step conclusion is success.

suites.name: Packaged native UI smoke
suites.skipCounterMeaning: No skip counter is emitted by the receipt.
suites.countBasis: One emitted native UI receipt with passed=true and exitCode=0; this is one aggregate run, not a count of internal assertions.

coreScope: Native host origin/method boundaries, permitted external sites, display scale mapping and quit policy.
JSON boolean/number distinctions, absolute drive/UNC/POSIX path handling, destination root protection, Unicode paths, exclusive creation, safe file reads/removal and atomic replacement.

Actual bundled helper plus pinned rclone: discovery, appearance/account configuration, dry run, copy, unchanged sync and destination extras, reports/task import/export, retry/quit state, graceful cancellation and restart persistence.
Installed package native IPC: two file panes, page buttons, expected platform, retained green-dark appearance, English language, native zoom and restored width, clean exit.

nativeUI.unit: one aggregate native UI smoke invocation

startup.harness: Actual AppKit NSWindow, production RcloneWebView/WKWebView and bundled React startup surface; controlled white documents exercise the presentation gate.

coverage.nativeEventHarness: MacInterfaceTests uses controlled HTML; MacNavigationIntegrationTests connects native events to production React and real rclone directories.
coverage.webScope: The Chromium suite covers the web UI; it is not evidence that AppKit or WKWebView executed.

limitations.macSigning: Ad-hoc only; no Developer ID signature or Apple notarization.
limitations.downloadHelperSignatureScope: Checks the code-signature envelope and Mach-O signature fields; cryptographic verification is performed by macOS CI, not the download helper.
limitations.dockAfterQuit: Uses the fixed purple bundle icon after quit; no persistent Finder metadata icon write is reintroduced.
limitations.manualHardwareAndAccounts: Physical mouse behavior, the user's own Dock rendering, live cloud accounts, and every desktop configuration are outside this automated evidence.
